response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT SUM(articount) AS artifact_total FROM scanfeatures), unit_shares AS (SELECT f.zoneref, f.articount, CAST(f.articount AS REAL) / t.artifact_total AS share FROM scanfeatures AS f CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.artifact_total IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM unit_shares) SELECT u.zoneref AS site_code, u.articount AS artifact_count, u.share, u.share - a.mean_share AS share_difference FROM unit_shares AS u CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE a.mean_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
